description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Lions of the Emperor — ON GILDED WINGS (WP-C46): at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is unengaged, you can place that unit in strategic reserves. Fixture ork11e_o34_active (P1 Orks active, P2 Custodes — Lions of the Emperor); setup privileges: CP 0 for both, the Allarus Custodians (TERMINATOR) repositioned clear of the Beast Snagga Boyz (unengaged), and the owed fights marked resolved (no attacks under test). The Orks end the Fight phase with the real End Fight Phase button, both Consolidate halves are passed; the fight_phase_end window opens for the Custodes player with the free ON GILDED WINGS card; a real click on 'Use on Allarus Custodians' places the unit in strategic reserves (status IN_RESERVES, reserve_type strategic_reserves, repositioned flag, tokens off the board) without spending CP.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the owed fights are marked resolved (no attacks under test)

steps.script:
var d = tree.current_scene._phase_end_confirm
if d != null and d.visible:
	d.get_ok_button().pressed.emit()
return true
